flash_bytes.reason: +2,496 B over the 4,061,792 B ceiling recorded at c75104d4 (#168): #170 ends a DEV USB session only after the raw SOF monitor reports the host absent for 250 ms, keeps DEV console writes within HWCDC's free ring space while its link flag is up (wait up to 5 ms per ring-sized part, then skip and count), adds the DEV `USB link` row of link and session-end totals, and counts a PUT lost to the link or a transmit stall by the lease's exit reason. An nm diff of the two clean ELFs puts the .flash.text growth (+2,282 B) mainly in app_runtime::run_loop::loop_body (10,798 -> 11,452 B, the inlined row), a second home_clock::write_clock_log instance (530 -> 1,080 B over two copies), update_ui::ModeUi::new (0 -> 370 B, now out of line and built in place; run_update 468 -> 228 B), SerialConsole::write_bytes (0 -> 188 B), serial_console::link_up (0 -> 166 B, the debounce) and publication::Published::poll (1,054 -> 1,112 B, the inlined PUT end reason), plus small inlining changes; .flash.rodata grows +184 B (the row text) and 30 B is image alignment. Control: a clean build of 5c2e5dcf (main without the change) measures 4,061,792 B. Clean regional DEV USB build with the pinned Python at e97901d3: 4,064,288 B. RAM 124,096 -> 124,096 B (+0 B; the Bridge keeps a one-byte end-reason mask in its tail padding and stays 664 B), RTC 300 -> 300 B (+0 B), lent Wi-Fi RAM 22,528 -> 22,528 B (+0 B), selected stacks +0 B (open_selected_profile 480 <= 656 B). Stack: the link watch and totals (<= 28 B) live in the reader's Application and update mode's ModeUi, not in static RAM; owner OK 2026-11-26: -64 B reader stack, no static RAM. Virtual X3 evidence (simulator, not hardware), same flow on both builds: reader stack-min-free 6,756 -> 6,692 B (deferred_start::body frame 1,328 -> 1,392 B), heap-min-free unchanged (65,508 B); update mode's run_update frame 1,104 -> 1,120 B (+16 B, ModeUi's watch). Usable app space 7,016,448 B; headroom 2,954,656 B (42.11%) -> 2,952,160 B (42.07%). No memory floor or stack ceiling moves.
